quote: We conduct this investigation using the SummEval dataset, the largest corpus of English-language human annotated text summaries widely available. We translate this dataset from English to seven languages and evaluate the correlations between automated summary evaluation measures and human annotations.

We translate this dataset from English to seven languages ... It consists of ... 17 machine-generated summaries produced by different models. ... Each machine-generated summary is annotated by three experts and five crowd workers using a five-point scale for four quality measures: coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance.
A large summarization dataset includes thousands of texts and human-written summaries (for example, CNN/Daily Mail).
